subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your upcoming flight booking from New York to Paris on June 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: XY123, Departure Time: 10:00 AM, Arrival Time: 4:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Airline Team
